verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents one built-in event-to-action link: transformations run automatically after a connection sync completes, or on a schedule. Only the after-sync path counts as event-driven; the schedule option is a recurring timer, not an event rule. There is no evidence of a general rule engine where users define their own triggers, conditions and actions; 'Fivetran Alerts' appears only as a page title. Missing for 10: user-definable rule/condition logic, multiple event types beyond sync completion, configurable action types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
